page.overview:
Who is Tao Trio?

The Tao Trio is a trio of Legendary Pokémon introduced in Generation V. They are native to the Unova region.

{| class="article-table" style="width:75%" ! style="width:5%" | Pokédex number ! Image ! Pokémon ! Type

All three members of the Tao Trio are version mascots of a Generation V game. Reshiram is the version mascot of and Zekrom of even though they are colored white and black, respectively. Black Kyurem and White Kyurem are the version mascots of , respectively.

Reshiram and Zekrom value truth and ideals the most, respectively. Meanwhile, Kyurem waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
